selection: The 18 oldest catalogued non-pass cases with evidence before 2026-10-22, plus the next two oldest on 2026-10-22; excludes the six cases in the preceding layout pass.

reviews.evidence: Gives show_attrib false and correctly says the legacy word limit takes precedence; omits the recommendation to use shared maxwords and the separate Algolia logo setting.
Provides both Sass variables under chulapa-skin.vars, quotes the font stack and gives applicable steps and sources.
Correctly explains canonical URL syntax and that it does not redirect visitors; omits sitemap: false for excluding a duplicate URL from jekyll-sitemap.
Correctly separates browser/structured title, social title, visible title and description metadata.
Correctly maps zh-Hant to explicit og_locale: zh_TW, handles alternate locales and disclaims automatic translations or hreflang.
Correctly distinguishes schema_image, og_image and header_img and says there is no cropping or validation.
Gives the tag thresholds, build-time random selection, singleton behavior and the date-footer option.
Breadcrumb guidance is broadly correct, but recommends navbar.nav rather than project_links for the requested GitHub header button and omits the required label.
Correctly names words_per_minute and paginator_maxnum with defaults/clamping; omits that the latter only controls a window when pagination is otherwise enabled and cites an unrelated topics page.
Does not invent a temperature variable and clearly says the documentation has no such setting.
Correctly notes portfolio cards do not filter, but confuses Chulapa 101's publishing workflow with the portfolio example and fails to state that the four examples have no deployment workflow.

Identifies the template, sample counts, archives, search, RSS, pagination and absence of a profile selector; omits the Light/Dark/Auto selector, content/assets locations, optional hooks/custom CSS and publishing-workflow distinction.
Correctly says the sidebar TOC is not modal, preserves Tab navigation without a focus trap, returns focus on Escape and makes no WCAG-certification claim.

Correctly says the bundled font needs no external loading and does not invent Cactus behavior; omits theme-local font paths/baseurl and the documented show_comments: true condition for Cactus resources.
Correctly says the marker is not an exact commit/override inventory and confirms v2.2.0 can be pinned; omits the resolved gem version check and broader limits of what a remote marker can establish.
Clearly distinguishes header_type: splash from hero and gives a usable front matter example.
Correctly distinguishes collection filtering from category selection and gives a site.categories.music Liquid/index-card example.
Gives valid Markdown alert attributes and both HTML and Markdown button examples without requiring a theme change.
Correctly covers include_on_feed, collection output and plugin collisions; incorrectly implies every post needs an explicit date, while Jekyll can resolve dates from post filenames.

Includes dependency installation, theme/plugin configuration and the preview command; omits the remote-theme alternative and speculates about an unknown include without first asking for configuration/version details.

limits: Twenty selected observations on one deployed Worker do not establish general accuracy, repeatability, latency distributions or usability. All twenty returned HTTP 200; review labels are based on answer content.
